pages.title: Chronosteel Coil Block
pages.text: A superconducting coil wrapped in chronosteel, so that current inside it runs on its own clock. The field it makes is steadier than any ordinary coil, as though the coil had more time to think. It hums at a low, even pitch.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Heavier recipes wanted hotter coils that would not drift. Wrapping a superconducting coil in chronosteel let me slow the coil's own time relative to its load, so it never quite overheats.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Essence Distillery, Spacetime Alloy Coil Block, Spacetime Anchor Pylon, Stellar Plasma Crucible.
